new_physical_hypotheses: An isolated incoming pair is evaluated in its centre-of-momentum frame, with total positive energy M and no recoil sink or other outgoing remnant.
Each emitted ideal massless ray points along either sign of its extracted triangle normal; no intervening reorientation or momentum broadening is supplied.

The generic edge-output search class partitions all six input vertices into two nondegenerate triangles, using each vertex exactly once. This is a restricted extraction class, not a classification of independent photon factors.
Conserved positive-energy massless four-momenta are a necessary support condition on a conversion operator, not a rule fixing its coupling or probability.
falsifier_for_the_restricted_candidate: An open interval of admissible edge placements on which none of the ten output partitions has parallel normals excludes two-ray exclusive conversion under the frozen readout. The original ACE/BDF template has a stronger all-angle obstruction.
